QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] Medina's Worries
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bMedina#k in the#bAzwan Refugee Zone#k.
QuestInfo.2: The ancient kingdom of Azwan fell to Hilla's evil schemes. She sacrificed the whole kingdom to gain everlasting youth for herself. There is a chance that a similar tragedy may occur if others come across Hilla. \r\n\r\n#bPrime Minister Longorias#k will explain the mission to you.
QuestInfo.1: The ancient kingdom of Azwan fell to Hilla's evil schemes. She sacrificed the whole kingdom to gain everlasting youth for herself. There is a chance that a similar tragedy may occur if others come across Hilla. \r\n\r\n#bPrime Minister Longorias#k will explain the mission to you.

0.msg: You are... Ah, I see. Gardin sent you. \r\nI'm glad you're here. The king is reluctant to bring foreign armies to Azwan, so I've been looking for help on my own.

1.msg: A #bstrange rumor#k has people pouring into Azwan. \r\nI'm afraid that #bHilla#k is trying to amass her forces to bring an evil scheme to fruition.

2.msg: Yes, and there's a possibility that the #bsame fate#k that befell Azwan will strike down Ariant.

4.msg: #bHilla#k was once the head shamaness of Azwan, and she used the people of Azwan as pawns in her schemes. Can you believe that? #rOne woman's fall turned a magnificent kingdom and its brilliant legacy into ashes in a matter of days. \r\n

5.msg: Why would she do such a thing?

6.msg: She probably sought the fabled #beverlasting youth#k. \r\nThis rumor seems to be a result of linking Hilla's immortality and Azwan.

7.msg: Do you see what I fear?\r\n#rWe must stop anyone who seek immortality from finding Hilla#k. I cannot even fathom what she schemes to use them for.\r\n

yes.0: You can hear the details of the mission from #bPrime Minister Longorias#k.

1.0: I am #bLongorias#k, the Prime Minister of Azwan. Not that there's anything left to minister...

default.0: The Prime Minister is right next to me.
